careers.heroSub: Build Africa’s invisible infrastructure. We are looking for brilliant minds to fuse hardware, software and strategic intelligence.
careers.whyJoinKicker: Don’t just write code. Build the infrastructure of an entire continent.

whyJoinPoints.title: A Unique Mission:
whyJoinPoints.p: At QUARANTES, we don’t build plain SaaS applications. We build the Operating System of Africa’s real economy. Our mission is to digitize and optimize the vital, informal sectors that make the continent thrive.

whyJoinPoints.title: State-of-the-Art Deeptech:
whyJoinPoints.p: You will work at the frontier of technological innovation. From designing agentic AI models (KARABA) to manufacturing Edge Computing hardware and mechatronics (KOF Corporation), you will take on unprecedented engineering challenges.

whyJoinPoints.title: Tangible Impact:
whyJoinPoints.p: Your work will have direct, measurable ripple effects. Whether optimizing last-mile logistics, informing government decisions or securing critical data, you will actively contribute to Africa’s technological and economic rise.

careers.innovationRadicalDesc: Join an ecosystem where technological boldness meets the realities of the African field.
careers.rdHeading: Quarantes Studio: The Frontier of Research
careers.rdP: Within Quarantes Studio, our innovation lab, Research & Development roles don’t just follow trends: they create them.

rdPoints.title: Agentic AI:
rdPoints.p: Designing autonomous architectures capable of making complex decisions in low-connectivity environments.

rdPoints.title: Edge AI & Mechatronics:
rdPoints.p: Integrating optimized LLM models directly onto embedded chips and fast-prototyping hardware solutions.

rdPoints.title: Foundational Research:
rdPoints.p: Publishing research papers and contributing to the global state of the art from the African continent.
